customManagers.description: Track the cosign-release input pinned in release.yml so Renovate keeps cosign patched within the allowed range.

packageRules.description: Keep cosign on 2.x: 3.x dropped --tlog-upload=false / --output-signature (needs a --signing-config), which breaks the no-public-Rekor COI signing flow in release.yml. Moving to 3.x is a deliberate, tested migration, not an auto-bump.

Automerge low-risk GitHub Actions bumps. Actions are SHA-pinned (CLAUDE.md), CI gates every PR, and minor/patch/digest carry no API breakage. Majors stay manual (e.g. setup-go v5->v6 changes the runner Node).

Automerge Docker base-image digest pins (same image, new digest). Tag bumps (minor/major) stay manual because they can need toolchain alignment - e.g. a golang tag bump must move go.mod + the release pipeline in lockstep, an alpine bump must be validated against the synthetic build.

Hold the csd-authored gadgets' inspektor-gadget SDK (wasmapi/go) at PinnedIGVersion. A gadget must be built against the same ig version it runs on; bumping the SDK ahead of the pinned ig binary (internal/ig/ig.go: PinnedIGVersion) causes build-vs-runtime ABI skew. It moves ONLY as part of a deliberate ig pin bump (new testdata/ig-versions/<v> fixtures + reference-image smoke), not via Renovate.

The app-tier verification fixtures (testdata/apptier/**) pin a SPECIFIC deployment's images (immich-server v2.7.5 + its matched postgres/valkey) for a reproducible stack — the derived caps and test flow are version-matched, so an auto-bump (especially a major like immich v3) defeats the point. Pin them by hand alongside a real re-derivation.
